name: Open the LMS application
actual: Application loaded with title "Athena LMS | Sign In"

name: Open the librarian login page
actual: Login form and credentials input are displayed

name: Log in with valid librarian credentials
actual: Librarian dashboard opened successfully

name: Log in with an invalid username
actual:
Login rejected with message: "⚠️
Invalid username or password."

name: Log in with an incorrect password
actual:
Error displayed: "⚠️
Invalid username or password."

name: Submit login with empty credentials
actual:
Validation message appeared: "⚠️
Please enter your username."

name: View dashboard statistics
expected: Book, member and issue statistics appear
actual: Stats verified: 8 books, 30 available, 5 members, 3 issued

name: Navigate to the Books tab
actual: Book catalogue opened successfully

name: Navigate to the Members tab
actual: Member directory opened successfully

name: Navigate to the Issues tab
actual: Circulation interface opened successfully

name: Navigate to the Fines tab
actual: Fine management interface opened successfully

name: Open the Add Book form
actual: Add Book modal form is displayed

name: Add a valid new book
testData: Title: Clean Architecture, Author: Robert C. Martin, Copies: 3
actual: Valid new book saved and listed with ISBN 978-0130007791

name: Search for an existing book
actual: Found matching book "The Pragmatic Programmer"

name: Clear the book search
expected: Catalogue returns to its normal listing
actual: Search cleared and full catalogue listing restored

name: Open the Add Member form
actual: Add Member modal form is displayed

name: Register a valid member
actual: Valid member registered with Code MEM-5976

name: Add a book with an empty title
actual: Empty title rejected with message: "Book title is required and cannot be empty."

name: Add a book with an empty author
expected: Required-field validation appears, if required by the form
actual: Empty author rejected with message: "Author is required and cannot be empty."

name: Add a book with an empty ISBN
expected: Submission is rejected if ISBN is mandatory
actual: Empty ISBN rejected with message: "ISBN is required and cannot be empty."

name: Add a book with a duplicate ISBN
actual: Duplicate ISBN rejected: "A book with ISBN "978-0132350884" already exists in the system"

name: Enter a very long book title
actual: Input handled long string (440 chars) safely without crashing

name: Search using an empty query
expected: Catalogue handles the empty query correctly
actual: Empty search query handled safely, table rendered properly

name: Search for a nonexistent title
actual: Nonexistent title returned zero matching records as expected

name: Search using special characters
actual: Special characters search handled safely without SQL/DOM errors

name: Register a member with an empty member code
actual: Empty code rejected: "Member Code / ID is required and cannot be empty."

name: Register a member with an empty name
actual: Empty name rejected: "Member name is required and cannot be empty."

name: Register a member with an invalid email
actual: Invalid email rejected: "Please provide a valid email format (e.g. name@example.com)."

name: Register a member with an empty email
expected: Submission is rejected if email is mandatory
actual: Empty email rejected: "Email address is required."

name: Register a member with a duplicate member code
actual: Duplicate member code rejected: "Member ID / Code "MEM-1001" is already in use by another member"

name: Enter an unusually long member name
expected: Input is handled without breaking the form
actual: Handled unusually long name (240 chars) without breaking the form

name: Enter letters in a phone-number field
actual: Phone field input "ABC-PHONE-XYZ" handled per application specifications

name: Submit an issue form without selecting a book
actual: Issue rejected without book selection: "Please select a book to issue."

name: Attempt to issue a book with no available copies
actual: Out-of-stock books are prevented from issue per inventory rules

name: Add a book and search for it
actual: Saved and searched: "Integration Test Book 1792588535195" found in table

name: Add a book and refresh the catalogue
actual: Book persists across browser reloads

name: Add a book and verify dashboard statistics
expected: Total book count updates as designed
actual: Dashboard total titles updated to 10

name: Search by ISBN and verify the matching record
actual: Search by ISBN 978-0201633610 returned Design Patterns

name: Reject a duplicate ISBN and recheck the catalogue
actual: Rejected duplicate ISBN, verified no record was created

name: Register a member and search by member code
actual: Member search by code MEM-1002 returned Bob Smith

name: Register a member and refresh the directory
actual: Member directory persists on reload

name: Reject an invalid email and inspect the directory
actual: Invalid member was rejected and not stored in directory

name: Issue a book and inspect the active-issues table
actual: Book issued and verified in active issues table

name: Issue a book and verify available-copy count
actual: Available copies count verified: decremented to 5

name: Attempt a duplicate active loan and inspect issue records
testData: Re-issue same book to same member
actual: Duplicate active loan prevented: "Member "Emma Watson" already has an active unreturned copy of "Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS)""

name: Return an issued book and inspect the active-issues table
expected: Returned loan is no longer active
actual: Returned loan no longer appears in active issues table

name: Return a book and verify its availability
actual: Available count incremented back to 6 copies

name: Return a book and inspect circulation history
actual: Circulation history records Emma Watson return with status RETURNED

name: Update fine settings and reload the settings
actual: Fine settings updated and persisted across reload ($4.25/day)

name: Perform a transaction and verify its recorded status
expected: Transaction data matches the completed operation
actual: Transaction ledger accurately reflects all completed operations
